key.name: hotkey
key.description: Keybinding used to toggle the Nexus Launcher overlay.

key.name: dock-apps
key.description: List of application desktop IDs pinned to the Nexus Launcher dock.

key.name: search-fields
key.description: Fields used when filtering the application list.

key.name: case-sensitive
key.description: Whether search filtering should be case sensitive.

key.name: search-hint
key.description: Hint text displayed in the search entry.

key.name: card-size
key.description: Controls the layout scale of the launcher cards.

key.name: opacity
key.description: Overall opacity of the entire launcher overlay.

key.name: surface-color
key.description: Background color of the main launcher surface.

key.name: surface-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the main launcher surface background color.

key.name: card-color
key.description: Background color of the app card panel.

key.name: card-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the app card panel background color.

key.name: blur-enabled
key.description: Whether the frost-glass blur effect is applied to the launcher surface.

key.name: blur-radius
key.description: Strength of the frost-glass blur applied to the launcher surface.

key.name: magnification
key.description: How much the launcher surface magnifies the background behind it, like looking through a thick pane of glass.

key.name: github-url
key.description: URL opened by the GitHub quick-action pill.

key.name: linkedin-url
key.description: URL opened by the LinkedIn quick-action pill.

key.name: mail-url
key.description: URL opened by the Mail quick-action pill.
